tree.heading: DTS Network
tree.text: The term “DTS Network” means the worldwide telecommunications network supporting all United States Government agencies and departments operating from diplomatic and consular facilities outside of the United States.

tree.heading: DTS–PO
tree.text: The term “DTS–PO” means the Diplomatic Telecommunications Service Program Office.

tree.heading: Governance Board
tree.text: The term “Governance Board” means the Diplomatic Telecommunications Service Governance Board established under section 7302(a)(1) of this title.

notes.heading: Prior Provisions
notes.text: A prior section 7304, Pub. L. 106–567, title III, § 324, Dec. 27, 2000, 114 Stat. 2846, which related to general provisions, was repealed by Pub. L. 111–259, title V, § 501(a)(1), Oct. 7, 2010, 124 Stat. 2735.
